author: Gmelin, 1789
status: 텃새 수천 마리 · 여름철새 수백 마리
summary: 평지 숲과 과수원, 농경지 언저리에 사는 직박구리로, 나무 위에서 열매와 곤충, 거미류를 잡아먹는다. 경계심이 비교적 적은 편이며 나뭇가지에 앉아 ‘깩- 깩’ 하고 울고, 날 때는 물결치듯 오르내린다. 국외에서는 대만, 중국 남부, 하이난섬, 베트남 북부에 분포한다. 우리나라에서는 2002년 10월 전라북도 어청도에서 처음 확인된 뒤 전라남도 하태도와 홍도 등지에서도 관찰되며 기록이 늘고 있다.

art.subject: Light-vented Bulbul (Pycnonotus sinensis), adult (sexes alike): forehead and forecrown black; a broad white patch covers the rear crown and nape; black and blackish-brown marks on the hindneck; face blackish, with a small white spot in the blackish-brown ear-coverts; throat white; upperparts dark greenish-grey; flight feathers and tail feathers edged greenish-yellow; a grey-brown band across the upper breast; belly dull white; undertail coverts white; short black bill; dark eye; black legs.
art.pose: perched on an orchard branch, calling
art.scene: lowland woodland edge and orchard on a southwestern Korean island; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched on a branch top: black forecrown, white rear crown and nape, blackish face with a small white ear spot, white throat, greenish-grey back with yellow-green wing and tail edges, grey-brown breast band, dull white belly and white vent
adult, head in profile: black forehead and forecrown, broad white rear crown and nape, blackish-brown ear-coverts with a small white spot, white throat, short black bill
art.build: Medium-small, slim bulbul: noticeably larger and longer-tailed than a sparrow, clearly smaller and shorter-tailed than a Brown-eared Bulbul. Rounded head with no crest; the crown feathers lie smooth. Bill short and black, slightly curved along the culmen, shorter than the head. Legs short and black. Wings short and rounded; at rest the wingtips reach just past the base of the tail. Tail fairly long and square-ended. Perches conspicuously on branch tops and wires, calling; flight undulating.
avoid: Do not paint the grey streaked body, long tail and chestnut ear patch of Brown-eared Bulbul (Hypsipetes amaurotis).
Do not paint a red or yellow vent; the undertail coverts are white.
Do not give it a pointed crest or a red whisker patch (Red-whiskered Bulbul).
Do not carry the white head patch forward to the forehead; the front of the crown is black.
